title: The prepare-commit-msg hook puts a blank line before KB-Work on an amend, splitting the trailer paragraph
goal: The prepare-commit-msg hook does not insert a blank line before KB-Work when the message's last paragraph already holds trailers (an amend keeps one trailer paragraph), with a test named prepare_commit_msg_amend_keeps_trailers that amends a commit in a throwaway repository. Found twice by BG-6dmpzx4t and BG-76xfour5 (workers rewrote with commit --amend -F).
repro_reason: the hook runs on commit --amend, which a repro cannot drive without a repository; the text match shows no trailer-paragraph check in the hook
